title: Filtered free resolution of a complex
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and let $M^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There exists a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] $P^\bullet\to M^\bullet$ and an increasing filtration by subcomplexes $0=F_{-1}P^\bullet\subset F_0P^\bullet\subset F_1P^\bullet\subset\cdots\subset P^\bullet$ such that $P^\bullet=\bigcup_iF_iP^\bullet$, every inclusion $F_iP^\bullet\to F_{i+1}P^\bullet$ is termwise split, and each quotient $F_{i+1}P^\bullet/F_iP^\bullet$ is isomorphic as a complex to a direct sum of shifts $A[k]$.

source.place: Differential Graded Algebra, Lemma 15.60.9 (Tag 09KP), proof; the specialization to ordinary rings is used in More on Algebra, Remark 15.60.11 (Tag 09PB)
